question: ________ is a storytelling classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Kuchipudi dance originated in Kuchipudi village of Krishna district of modern Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It was conceived in 17th century by Vaishnava poet Siddhendra Yogi.
 
• It begins with an invocation to Lord Ganesha followed by Nri
